verdict.rationale: Porkbun's docs describe signed, real-time webhook notifications for registrations, renewals, transfers, upcoming expirations and DNS changes as a replacement for polling. The verification guide specifies the HMAC-SHA256 signature scheme, and the sandbox key also delivers signed webhooks for testing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how subscriptions are created and managed (endpoint registration, event filtering, retry policy), and independent or hands-on corroboration that delivery works as claimed.
